 Panchayat 5 delayed? Prime Video's latest post leaves fans disappointed
 By Wion Web Desk Published: Nov 15, 2026, 17:33 IST | Updated: Nov 15, 2026, 17:33 IST Panchayat 5 Photograph: (Instagram) 
 Story highlights Prime Video has hinted that Panchayat Season 5 will not be released this year through a social media post featuring Durgesh Kumar's Banrakas. Read on to know more.
 Fans of Panchayat may have to wait a little longer before returning to Phulera. Prime Video has sparked conversations on social media after sharing a new post suggesting that the fifth season of the popular series will not arrive this year.
 Will Panchayat Season 5 arrive this year?
 Featuring Durgesh Kumar, who plays Bhushan Sharma aka Banrakas, the post has a message that has caught viewers' attention. "Panchayat Season 5. Is saal nahi aayega. batate hue khed hai, Panchayat ka agla season qaid hai" (Panchayat Season 5 will not arrive this year. We regret to inform you that the next season of Panchayat is on hold), it read.

 The update comes as a disappointment for viewers who have been looking forward to another instalment of the much-loved village drama.
 Internet reacts
 Expressing disappointment, one user wrote, "we want it this yearrrr." Another said, "Aww what a banger man." "So We got GTA 6 before Panchayat 5," read the third comment. "Nahiiiii Plsss Isi Year Mein Chahiyeee Hum Sab Koo," said another. One user said, "kab tak Panchayat s5 , aa jayega??"

 The announcement follows the dramatic changes in Season 4 that changed the political landscape of Phulera. In the village elections, Manju Devi (Neena Gupta) and Pradhan Ji (Raghubir Yadav) have lost.
 Also Read: Katrina Kaif reveals Vicky Kaushal helps her balance work and life 
 The new Pradhan was Kranti Devi (Sunita Rajwar) and her husband, Bhushan Sharma, better known as Banrakas (Durgesh Kumar), became a more powerful force in village politics.
 With the new leadership, Banrakas seems to be given a bigger say in Phulera’s affairs. He is a longtime rival of Pradhan Ji and may bring a new dynamic because of his growing stature.
